description: Poll the health endpoint until Docker services are ready (retries every 2s for up to 60s)

actions.comment: The poll below fetches a RELATIVE url, so it needs a same-origin document to resolve against. This module had no navigation of its own, so when it ran as the first step of a suite the page was still about:blank: every iteration threw instantly, the loop ran all 30 rounds, and the module reliably burned its full 60s before failing — which then surfaced as the test timing out rather than as 'Docker not ready'. /login is the cheapest same-origin page (shell-less, no API calls of its own).

actions.value: (async()=>{for(var i=0;i<30;i++){try{var r=await fetch('/api/health');if(r.ok){var j=await r.json();if(j.status==='ok'){window.__dockerReady=true;return}}}catch(e){}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000))}throw new Error('Docker services not ready after 60s')})()
